title: Hot & Cold Worksheets | PreK–K Preschool Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Standards aligned: K-PS3-1

Give your learners extra practice with Hot & Cold! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Hot or Cold?
  • Find Hot and Cold
  • A Cold Day, a Warm Cup
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Hot or Cold?, Find Hot and Cold, A Cold Day, a Warm Cup), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Pre-K Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
